title: Neo N3 asset identifiers (neo namespace)
description: Asset identifier shape for CAIP-2 neo networks (Neo N3). Fungible assets are NEP-17 contract script hashes in big-endian 0x + 40 hex form (same textual shape as EVM addresses, different semantics). Networks are identified as neo:<network-magic-decimal> per the ChainAgnostic neo CAIP-2 profile; MainNet is neo:860833102, TestNet is neo:860833103 (T3) and neo:12227332 is the Neo X sidechain testnet (which uses its own eip155-style namespace on other registries; Neo X mainnet is eip155:47763).
